scope: Only config.json, summary.json, comparison.json and progress.jsonl; no NPZ, response, private/split reads, scoring, fitting, edits or paid calls
checks: all global and 15-stratum arm/paired mean and sample SD values
15configured folds, hide partitions and coverage strata
original member identities, alphas, model seeds and grid metadata
summary/comparison/config hashes and exact baseline/additive correspondence
fixed weights and predeclared gate; ratio of means, not mean of ratios
limits: NPZ hashes/raw scoring checked by separate raw-array reviewer
same-cohort post-selection screen; no model promotion or CellForge evidence
candidate MSE/top20 MSE are higher than additive
